testimonials.name: Margaret T.
testimonials.text: Dr. Harrington performed my angioplasty after I was told I needed open-heart surgery by two other doctors. He found a better path forward, and I was back home the next day. His calm, thorough explanation of everything made a frightening situation manageable. I cannot thank him enough.

testimonials.name: Robert K.
testimonials.text: At 54, being told I needed valve replacement was terrifying. Dr. Harrington walked me through the TAVR procedure step by step and answered every question my family had. The procedure went perfectly. Six weeks later I was hiking with my grandchildren. This man gave me my life back.

testimonials.name: Linda P.
testimonials.text: The heart failure management program here is unlike anything I experienced elsewhere. They treat you as a whole person, not a diagnosis. The team checks in regularly and my condition has been stable for over a year now. Dr. Harrington is brilliant and genuinely caring.

testimonials.name: David M.
testimonials.text: I came in for a preventive evaluation after my father's heart attack. Dr. Harrington found elevated coronary calcium and put me on an aggressive but practical prevention plan. No dramatic interventions — just smart, evidence-based medicine. Two years later, my markers are significantly improved.

testimonials.name: Susan A.
testimonials.text: I was experiencing irregular heartbeat episodes and felt dismissed by my previous cardiologist. Dr. Harrington ordered a Holter monitor right away, identified the issue, and had a comprehensive treatment plan within the week. The difference in care quality is night and day.

testimonials.name: Carlos R.
testimonials.text: After my heart attack, I was transferred to Dr. Harrington for intervention. He performed an emergency stent placement and the outcome was remarkable. His entire team was professional and reassuring throughout. I feel like I was given a second chance, and I am deeply grateful.
